conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
A bit tired, to be honest. I’ve been putting in a lot of overtime and it’s catching up with me. I just want to relax and recharge for a bit.
What’s been the hardest part about not being able to truly relax?
Just the constant thinking, I guess. I find myself lying there thinking about all the things I need to do tomorrow, and it keeps me awake. I just wish I could turn my brain off.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah, definitely. I'll be in the middle of a meeting and my mind will start wandering off. It’s like my brain is saying, “Hey, we could be doing something way more fun than this.”
How often does that mind-wandering happen during a typical meeting?
Every time, honestly. I try to shake it off, but it’s hard to stay focused. I just sit there thinking, “I really need to get my priorities straight.”
How have you been sleeping lately?
It’s been hit-or-miss. Some nights I sleep fine, but others I wake up at 3 am and can’t get back to sleep. I just lie there thinking, “Why is my brain doing this to me?”
How long does it usually take you to fall back asleep when that happens?
Usually about an hour. I just try to relax and tell myself it’s normal. I don't want to get worked up over it.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Not as much as I should. I keep saying I’m going to start a new hobby, but I haven't found the time. I just keep putting it off.
What do you think gets in the way when you think about starting something new?
Just the fear of it not being good, I guess. I worry that I’ll waste my time and not be any good at it. So I just stick to my routine.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
More of the same, probably. Just trying to stay on top of things and not let things pile up.
What kinds of things feel like they’re piling up?
Just the usual stuff – work, bills, errands. I feel like I’m constantly playing catch-up.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah, definitely. I'll be looking at a recipe and think, “Is this really worth the effort?” and then just order takeout instead. I just feel really stuck, you know?
How long have you been feeling that stuck feeling when you're trying to decide?
I don't know, a few months? It just seems like every decision takes a lot more energy than it used to.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
I have the energy to get through it, but I feel like I’m running on fumes by the end of the day. I just want to curl up and sleep.
How long have you been feeling like you're running on fumes by the end of the day?
I don't know, a few weeks maybe? It’s like I’m just going through the motions.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
I try to be. I really do. But I just can't seem to find the motivation to do anything about it.
What does it feel like when you try to get motivated but can't?
It feels like I’m just stuck in neutral. I'll look at a project and think, “I should really do that,” and then just stare at it.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Just my general outlook, I guess. I feel like I’m stuck in a rut and I don't know how to get out of it.
What does being stuck in a rut feel like for you?
It feels like I’m just going through the motions and not actually living.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I feel like I should be doing better. I feel like I’m not really using my potential.
What do you think is holding you back from reaching that potential?
I don’t know, just myself, I guess.
How's your appetite been?
It’s been okay, I guess. I haven't really been hungry for anything.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
Yeah, I've lost a bit of weight. I don't really know what’s going on with my appetite.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
Yeah, a bit. I get annoyed at little things, and then I just feel guilty for snapping.
